fields.Title: Why Value Is Strongest
fields.Body:
Value for avid hotels is strongest when the asset can deliver the brand’s specific guest promise and the owner can execute platform obligations with discipline.
- Strongest where new-build and selected conversion sites where owners want midscale essentials with lean operations rather than upper-midscale Holiday Inn Express complexity.

- Weaker where the asset cannot support the avid guest promise or platform obligations.

fields.Title: Why Value Is Strongest
fields.Body:

- Owner diligence should center on broad demand base, conversion and new-build suitability, efficient operating model, and IHG distribution strength.

- Weaker where the asset cannot support the Holiday Inn Express guest promise or platform obligations.
